newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia awards Thai King honorary degree.
newsitem.headline: Australia awards Thai King honorary degree.

text.p: The Australian government said on Tuesday that Thailand's King Bhumibol Adulyadej had been awarded an honorary doctorate by the University of Canberra.

"The honorary doctorate has been awarded in recognition of His Majesty's outstanding contribution to the development of education in Thailand and his continued commitment to improving the quality of life in rural Thailand," Foreign Affairs Minister Alexander Downer said in a statement.
The award would boost the educational links between Australia and Thailand, including student exchanges and institutional ties, Downer said.
Australia has become Thailand's fastest growing student destination, second largest behind the United States, he said.
Downer visited Thailand in April and proposed the development of a 50:50 youth ambassadors' programme that he said would bring newly graduated Australians to Thailand to help with rural development.
